summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in the ControlCode union; rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07", the documented Control.title(title) classmethod returning cls((ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE, title)); rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif that calls term.set_title(title) (the wrapper's actual method name, which the spec calls set-title); rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, returning False when not a terminal and True after writing the control, with the required docstring; CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_control_title, test_set_window_title (skipped on Windows), and test_control_set_window_title (Windows only, mocked wrapper). Tests, black, and mypy were not run, per instructions; all checks were done by reading. No commits made.
